passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I like to travel, and I go on a short trip.
phrases.ko: 나는 여행하는 것을 좋아하고, 짧은 여행을 가요.

phrases.en: I look at a map before we go.
I see a new place, and I take a photo.
phrases.ko: 나는 새로운 장소를 보고, 사진을 찍어요.

phrases.en: I feel excited, and travel is fun.
My family likes a short trip on the weekend.
phrases.ko: 우리 가족은 주말의 짧은 여행을 좋아해요.

phrases.en: The map shows the new place.
I see rivers, parks, and small towns.
phrases.ko: 나는 강, 공원, 작은 마을을 봐요.

phrases.en: A photo helps me remember the trip.
I feel excited when the train starts.
Travel is fun because every place is a little new.
phrases.ko: 모든 장소가 조금 새로워서 여행은 재미있어요.

full_passage_spoken: I like to travel, and I go on a short trip. I look at a map before we go. We ride a train. I see a new place, and I take a photo. I feel excited, and travel is fun. My family likes a short trip on the weekend. The map shows the new place. I see rivers, parks, and small towns. A photo helps me remember the trip. I feel excited when the train starts. Travel is fun because every place is a little new.
